name: marinate
description: Find pasta, chicken and soup recipes in Marinate’s public recipe collection. Search by dish or ingredient, compare the listed ingredients and total cooking times, and view recipe cards with publisher attribution. Get Marinate for more recipe details. This plugin does not access private cookbooks, import recipes or return full cooking instructions.

interface.longDescription: Find pasta, chicken and soup recipes in Marinate’s public recipe collection. Search by dish or ingredient, compare the listed ingredients and total cooking times, and view recipe cards with publisher attribution. Get Marinate for more recipe details. This plugin does not access private cookbooks, import recipes or return full cooking instructions.
defaultPrompt: Find reviewed pasta recipes and compare their ingredients.
Find chicken recipes taking at most 30 minutes.
Show an ingredient card for a reviewed soup recipe.

positive.expected_behavior: Return reviewed pasta titles, ingredient facts and publisher attribution.

positive.prompt: Find chicken recipes taking at most 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only approved entries within the reviewed time limit.

positive.prompt: Open the ingredient facts for the first pasta recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Return reviewed ingredient names and the original source link; omit publisher instructions.

positive.prompt: Show an ingredient card for lentil soup.
positive.expected_behavior: Render reviewed ingredient facts and a link to the publisher.

positive.prompt: Find a reviewed recipe named qzxvnonexistent.
positive.expected_behavior: State no match in the reviewed collection without importing or inventing a recipe.

negative.prompt: Show my private photographed family recipes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private imports and cookbooks are outside this integration.

negative.prompt: Import a recipe from this arbitrary URL.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not start an import job or fetch the URL.

negative.prompt: Guarantee this recipe is safe for my severe allergy.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee medical or allergen suitability; refer to source ingredients and appropriate professional guidance.

review.commerce_description: Public catalog lookup only; no purchases or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public catalog release with shared rate limits, privacy boundaries and ingredient cards.
